content: For PWA offline storage: Cache API is for URL-addressable resources (app shell: JS/CSS/HTML). IndexedDB is for structured data (parsed subtitles, SRT text). The idb library (v8.0.3, ~1.19kB) by Jake Archibald provides a Promise-based wrapper. idb-keyval (v6.3.0) is even simpler for key-value use. For SRT subtitle storage, IndexedDB is the right choice because subtitle data needs timestamp-based querying and can exceed localStorage 5MB limit.
